title: Turmoil in the Holy City
summary: Using Source Arts, Ye Fan opens a wooden box left by Senior Zhang Lin and finds a Human Essence Fruit, a life-extending divine medicine; Hei Huang eats one raw and raves. Fifth Master Zhang recalls that the ancestors' stones came from the Holy City, an ancient city that fell from the sky at the end of a freshwater sea in the Northern Territory and holds the most source in the world. Stone Village moves away from Purple Mountain before the Holy Lands' assault. Because the Holy Lords are gathering and Yaoguang runs strict checks at the gates, a decoy stays behind robbing source stones as 'Ye Fan' while he slips into the city as Gu Feng. On the boat he meets Tuoba Chang, and in the city Tu Fei's friend Li Heishui shows him the Ancient Road Altar and tells him that only Miaoyu Nunnery still has a place left at the Source Arts conference. Gu Feng wins the lotus chase on An Miaoyi's jade boat against suitors such as Yao Yuekong, Xia Yiming and Xiang Yifei, which makes him the fairy's guest of honour.
